+       strictly-initialized<sup>PREVIEW</sup></externallink> instance fields and
+       slot 0 of the local variable array contains a reference to the object
+       containing the watched field.
+       For this purpose, the VM identifies the object being constructed by the
+       reference in slot 0 of the current constructor frame's local variable array.

-      generated during construction of an instance of the value class.
+      Consequently, events for watched instance fields of a value class are
+      not generated for accesses or modifications directly in its constructors.
